verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents OAuth 2.0 with a scopes catalog gating access per module, which provides a mechanism for issuing credentials with limited access rather than full account access, and MCP integration references agent-driven access. However, there is no evidence of fine-grained, per-action or per-record least-privilege scoping (e.g., read-only vs. write, or resource-level restriction) beyond module-level scopes, nor documentation of agent-specific credential issuance/revocation workflows distinct from human OAuth clients. missing for 10: granular least-privilege scope examples beyond module-level, agent-specific credential lifecycle management (issuance/rotation/revocation tailored to AI agents), independent/hands-on verification that scoped tokens restrict agent actions as claimed.
